title: J.J. McCarthy, Cam Skattebo deliver as Giants stun Texans, seize control of NFC East

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: J.J. McCarthy, Cam Skattebo deliver as Giants stun Texans, seize control of NFC East
sources.description: With the Cowboys and Eagles both struggling, there appeared to be no takers to compete for the NFC East. Maybe it's the New York Giants after all.
